subject.title: media:// image references bypass the resize ladder; media-understanding sends unresized images (oversized channel photos fail)

question: Which linked candidate should own the canonical fix for media-understanding image compression on this issue?
rationale: Three open external PRs overlap on the same source-proven bug, and current reviews still show proof or solution-fit blockers; automation should not create a fourth repair or close the issue before one candidate is selected or rejected.

options.title: Repair one linked PR
options.body: Choose the strongest existing PR, require shared model-aware compression plus real oversized-image proof, and close weaker candidates after preserving any useful context.

options.title: Pause all candidates
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers decide the exact compression-policy boundary before asking contributors to revise.

options.title: Queue a replacement later
options.body: Only queue a new fix after the open candidates are closed or clearly abandoned so ClawSweeper does not duplicate active contributor work.

recommendation.title: Repair one linked PR
recommendation.body: Choose the strongest existing PR, require shared model-aware compression plus real oversized-image proof, and close weaker candidates after preserving any useful context.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the existing model-aware image compression policy that the final fix should reuse.
